D0001.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0001.acceptanceRationale: Public IFrontend/worker and GenerateAsync preserve compiler-observed C/C++ declaration, prototype, type, storage, scalar/string constant and macro facts. Unsupported or contextual facts must remain unavailable instead of being fabricated. Generated source is validated independently; consumer compilation/linking/invocation belongs to repository acceptance tools. No NativeBuild, selected-compiler source-view fallback or Objective-C product surface remains.

D0002.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0002.acceptanceRationale: Worker protocol serializes and reconstructs stable IDs and detached type facts. Exact array extent/size/alignment, flexible unknown extent, alias element and pointer alignment remain separate. Returned callback arguments/result belong to its own function graph; both pointer-level const/volatile qualifiers survive. Public Host sees and compiles preserved callback/alias/anonymous storage graph. Limits: Unexposed/dependent types and unknown layout remain unknown, not inferred from equal size. Transport test is bounded; complete graph round-trip and malformed-reference invariants rely on the broader model/worker suites. Raw native storage facts do not certify by-value calling convention classification.

D0003.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0003.acceptanceRationale: Public IFrontend/worker and GenerateAsync preserve compiler-observed C/C++ declaration, prototype, type, storage, scalar/string constant and macro facts. Unsupported or contextual facts must remain unavailable instead of being fabricated. Generated source is validated independently; consumer compilation/linking/invocation belongs to repository acceptance tools. No NativeBuild, selected-compiler source-view fallback or Objective-C product surface remains.

D0004.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0004.acceptanceRationale: Neutral modules remain identical after physical project relocation, including anonymous nested types and transitive source identities; source-like literal bytes are deliberately preserved. Explicit generated source mappings and native preprocessor presumed locations retain logical provenance/system classification without changing physical input snapshots. Public Host C/C++ split/single generation carries detached summary/parameter/return sections through bridge reparse, parameter rename and generated XML compilation. Public generation failure reports original header plus correct analysis/backend stage code for over-aligned by-value types. Limits: Arbitrary documentation commands are inert text; full semantic interpretation of all Doxygen/XML commands is not claimed. Only explicitly owned source provenance is normalized; real path-sensitive literal bytes must not be rewritten. This is source-level coverage mapping, not a new same-revision test receipt.

D0005.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0005.acceptanceRationale: Pure neutral graph selection closes record fields/pointees/parameters without publishing unrelated methods, terminates cycles and is deterministic across input ordering. Actual worker results retain referenced dependency storage without selecting unrelated dependency exports. Explicit exclusions conflict with required storage/cleanup rather than silently truncating ABI; independent family/category filters do not suppress another family. Public Host C/C++ inspection/generation keeps exact selected callable and dependency fields/cleanup, rejects explicit exclusion, and does not synthesize excluded construction. Limits: Explicit configured cleanup/default/template/shim requirements can bypass positive root filters only through their checked required identities; exclusions remain strict. Header/selector matching follows frozen source-document path bases and exact identities; arbitrary regex-based AST mutation is an extension concern. Final release must execute full current neutral suites and record same-revision receipts.

D0006.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0006.acceptanceRationale: Exact native size, field offsets and alignment are checked independently; nested over-aligned records retain internal offsets; packed, union and flexible-array carriers are bounded and final emitted storage is rechecked. Limits: Size equality does not authorize by-value calls or over-aligned managed allocation.

D0007.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0007.acceptanceRationale: Calling classifiers inspect actual scalar fields, overlap and unaligned storage under an exact runtime/target profile; independent native round trips exercise arguments and returns; external matching storage cannot bypass unsupported calling ABI. Limits: Only explicitly implemented runtime/target classifications are admitted; other aggregate or special by-value shapes require a pointer shim. The exact opaque16-byte/8-alignment retired-IR case is independently rejected for every import, before any candidate emission. This is distinct from the existing96-byte/32-aligned and long-double policy cases.

D0008.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0008.acceptanceRationale: Complete explicit scalar field mappings statically bind from captured C# source or PE metadata without loading or building the consumer. Closed unmanaged non-ref-like structs with public writable scalar fields copy through separate generated raw native carriers. Source/metadata layout attributes, missing or changed frozen inputs, references, incomplete mappings and scalar kind/signedness/width mismatches reject. Matching storage never grants calling-ABI permission. Tests emit and externally compile/invoke all three import forms and Runtime package/source variants; no inferred CLR size, offsets or alignment is claimed.

D0009.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0009.acceptanceRationale: Unknown ownership, lifetime, callback/async registration and contradictory retention produce located diagnostics; declared and user-asserted evidence retain their original strength; the immutable input is unchanged. Limits: Assertions do not certify arbitrary native implementations. Friendly eligibility remains separate from exact raw ABI. Exact callback aliases and qualified pointees receive separate lifetime/thread warnings without invented contracts. Data pointers, callback storage pointers and misleading names do not. Missing fields, evidence levels, source locations, deduplication and strict full-publication rollback have separate assertions.

D0010.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0010.acceptanceRationale: Ordered naming policies, exact overrides, category and parameter names compile; storage offsets and native export identities remain unchanged; aliases invoke the original export; collisions fail before writes. Limits: Type replacement uses explicit checked projections and cannot authorize incompatible ABI. Explicit immutable English/Custom flat-word segmentation now has33 focused cases and2 real public Host/schema/cache cases. Defaults, lowercase/mixed/unknown fragments, exact mappings, concurrent vocabularies and native export names remain stable; custom vocabulary changes invalidate emission reuse. The one physical English resource uses pinned reproducible source/license provenance.

D0011.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0011.acceptanceRationale: Container and alias forwards preserve checked signatures, default arguments and runtime ownership; explicit C owned/value/address receivers use exact native identity and retain original storage or owned handles; cross-context and closed use is rejected. Limits: Borrowed owner/call lifetimes cannot gain an owned object automatically; configured source identities are required.

D0012.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0012.acceptanceRationale: A real native fixture composes renamed parameters, containers/defaults, string/Span/out values and unknown Raw pointers; unsupported ownership/encoding never gains a string or owned wrapper; exact source const-char return stays pointer-only. Limits: NULL-only default composition is under implementation; this proposal is incomplete until its exact combined fixture passes. The exact factory/member composition cannot reintroduce a friendly Clone pointer return after ownership eligibility rejected it. Raw exact pointers remain available and no invented owning/address object appears.

D0013.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0013.acceptanceRationale: Function tables are installed only after complete required symbols resolve; external extent/identity/address inputs are checked; independent contexts and provider disposal are exercised; exact Example.FunctionTable namespace and both package/source Runtime compile and invoke. Limits: External producer ABI identity is an assertion, independently checked calling capabilities still apply.

D0014.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0014.acceptanceRationale: Real SDK warnings-as-errors compilation and native invocation exercise static imports, checked scalar/aggregate/pointer carriers, text and buffers under DllImport with package/source runtime. Limits: Only actual mapped canonical Windows tests and explicit Linux/macOS smoke establish their stated execution scope; optional AOT/browser application receipts are separate evidence and are not mandatory generator gates.

D0015.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0015.acceptanceRationale: Actual SDK source-generator builds and native consumers exercise LibraryImport signatures using the same neutral semantic plans and exact native storage. Limits: Supported source-generated import capabilities remain profile-specific.

D0016.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0016.acceptanceRationale: Multiple context/provider states remain independent, context ownership is checked, static shared facades forward to the same context, and owned handles/callbacks/fresh text maintain their module lifetimes. Limits: Mapped owned C++ text cases cover counted input and fresh string results on owned receivers; their actual execution scope comes from the corresponding receipts. Retained native self is not reclassified as nonretaining.

D0017.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0017.acceptanceRationale: Named, anonymous, nested and empty union/raw storage retain compiler size/field positions; source aliases and relocation preserve identity; independently compiled native fixtures validate storage and allowed calls. Limits: Unknown or unsupported layout/calling behavior is rejected rather than guessed.

D0018.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0018.acceptanceRationale: Exact bit bounds/sign extension/Boolean/enum and full-width cross-byte operations are compared to native reads/writes, and final accessors are checked against compiler bit positions. Limits: Unknown or big-endian bit-order is explicitly unsupported without a proved adapter. The exact signed3-bit and unsigned1-bit four-byte carrier is compiled and all signed values are exercised against independent expected storage bits; adjacent setter writes must preserve each other.

D0019.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0019.acceptanceRationale: Array extents, storage and pointer indirection remain separate; finite primitive Span constructors validate every exact length then copy independent InlineArray fields; native size/offset/value oracle checks one-element storage. Limits: Flexible arrays are not fabricated as full inline arrays; pointer/enum/record/Boolean-special constructor shapes preserve raw carriers with explicit omissions.

D0020.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0020.acceptanceRationale: Signed/unsigned full-width values and negative literals retain exact bits, raw calls remain integral, managed aliases use explicit conversions, and processed enum/ABI tampering or overflow fails. Limits: Enum presentation does not change underlying native width or calling classification.

D0021.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0021.acceptanceRationale: Target-width wchar/long/bool/special storage facts are retained, unsupported long-double by-value calls fail, and the explicit AAPCS64 va_list carrier validates storage independently from other ABI families. Limits: A byte carrier or va_list shape is not general variadic-call support; only verified finite wrappers and explicit target capabilities are admitted.

D0022.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0022.acceptanceRationale: Explicit UTF8/16/32 input/result contracts establish code-unit width, length unit, terminator and cleanup domain. Actual native results prove exact extent, decoding, failure cleanup and release after context closure; generated temporary strings use matching per-context pairs. The formerly pending counted UTF8/16/32 input, standard path counted UTF8 helper and scoped standard-value string result now have exact real native tests across imports/Runtime modes; limits/copy/exception/invalid-encoding cleanup remain explicit.

D0023.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0023.acceptanceRationale: Explicit call-scoped value/buffer direction contracts pin original storage and preserve native aliasing across ref/ref, in/out, record-field and span overlap. Actual native writes and pointer identity prove capacity/written-count checks, directed values, owned dispatch and invalid overlap refusal before a native call.

D0024.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0024.acceptanceRationale: Explicit owned and module-borrowed native objects retain their originating context/release domain and actual native cleanup; borrowed storage has no invented destructor. Matching allocator pairs preserve extent/alignment and module leases. Arbitrary call-bound or owner-bound returns without a proved lifetime remain raw. An explicitly named missing string cleanup callable is preserved as a configuration error; it cannot silently fall back to borrowed semantics and must leave the complete prior publication unchanged.

D0025.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0025.acceptanceRationale: Explicit returned-handle and callback/userdata-pair registrations retain managed state until complete native-frame quiescence. Actual native threads, self-close, exception fallback, context closure and all three imports by both Runtime modes exercise exact unregister protocols. Blocking/unknown shutdown is omitted on profiles that cannot safely join. Explicit Browser EventLoop generation protocols remain separate from optional installed browser application receipts; those receipts establish only their own exact functional/lifecycle execution scope and are not mandatory generator or release gates.

D0026.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
D0026.acceptanceRationale: Explicit completion/cancellation callbacks retain pinned Memory until full native stop/join, including native accesses after terminal signal, cancellation acknowledgement, inline completion and context closure. Unsupported terminal/retention shapes keep raw access. Generic polling/wait/custom scheduling is not inferred from old validation metadata.

D0027.scopeJustification: The complete functional baseline executes once on Windows; separate Linux/macOS real parser/generation/native-call smoke does not claim full platform functional certification.
